messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On the 2025-08-01 rotation day, Marcus handed the Team Boreal pager to Lena. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-01]
- Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year. [valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-13]
- As of 2026-02-19, the Boreal team consists of Lena only, after Marcus moved to Team Atlas. [valid 2026-02-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-19]
    earlier: As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-02-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- As of 2026-02-19, Lena has the Team Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [valid 2026-02-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-19-2]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-26, Marcus has the Team Boreal pager this cycle; pages for anything should go to Marcus, not Lena. [valid 2025-12-26 to 2026-02-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-26]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-31, Lena has the Team Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [valid 2025-10-31 to 2025-12-26; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-10-31]
- As of 2026-03-12, Lena is the contact to page for anything related to Team Boreal. [valid 2026-03-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-12]
- As of 2025-10-27, the scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- As of the 2025-06-05 rotation day, Marcus is the primary on-call for Team Boreal, and Lena is off rotation. [valid 2025-06-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-05]
    earlier: As of the 2025-04-16 rotation day, Lena carries the Team Boreal on-call phone, having received the pager from Marcus. [valid 2025-04-16 to 2025-06-05; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-16]
    earlier: Marcus carries the Team Boreal on-call phone from the 2025-02-27 rotation swap until the next rotation. [valid 2025-02-27 to 2025-04-16; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-27]
- As of 2026-02-23, the scheduler's deploy window remains weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-02-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-23]
- INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [decision; valid 2025-06-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Team Boreal holds its planning meeting on Thursdays. [valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- On 2025-11-20, Team Boreal took over the event bus from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
